\section{Reproducibility}\label{app:reproducibility}

From the manuscript directory, run
\begin{verbatim}
python3 supplement/verify_finite_block.py \
  --output supplement/finite_block_certificate.json
python3 supplement/verify_independent.py \
  --output supplement/independent_certificate.json
python3 -m unittest -v supplement/test_verify_finite_block.py
\end{verbatim}
The expected result is eleven passing tests and
\texttt{all\_checks\_pass: true} in both JSON files.  No third-party Python
package is required.

Compile the paper with
\begin{verbatim}
latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error \
  -outdir=build main.tex
\end{verbatim}
The submission archive includes source, bibliography, both verifiers, tests,
the two JSON certificates, the PDF, and the build report.  File hashes and the
runtime version are recorded alongside the archive.
